summary: Vaxart, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on September 14, 2026, disclosing that its Board approved two governance policies on September 3, 2026. The Director Resignation Policy requires an uncontested-election director receiving more withhold than for votes to promptly tender a resignation, with the Nominating and Governance Committee reviewing and the Board acting within 90 days of vote certification. The Director Stock Ownership Policy sets a target of two times the annual cash retainer for non-employee directors, measured annually using a 90-day moving average as of December 31. No special-situation transaction, no deal terms, and no advisor are involved; this is routine governance disclosure. Watch for exhibit filings with the next periodic report.
